tiles.name: SMART
tiles.exec:
printf '['
n=0
for dev in $(sudo -n smartctl --scan 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); do
  out=$(sudo -n smartctl -H "$dev" 2>/dev/null)
  case "$out" in
    *PASSED*|*"Health Status: OK"*) state=ok; word=passed ;;
    *FAILED*|*FAILING*) state=bad; word=failing ;;
    *) state=unknown; word="no answer" ;;
  esac
  name=${dev#/dev/}
  [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && printf ','
  printf '{"id":"smart_%s","name":"%s","type":"status","value":"%s","label":"SMART %s"}' "$(printf '%s' "$name" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_-' '_')" "$name" "$state" "$word"
  n=$((n + 1))
done
printf ']\n'
